(* ============ canonicity of operator results ============ *)
Lemma Step_unop_src : forall op z e2, Step (ExpUnOp op z) e2 -> isValue z -> exists b, z = Bc b.
Proof.
  intros op z e2 H Hv.
  destruct (Step_UnOp_inv op z e2 H) as [[e0 [Hst Heq]] | [w [pf [He [Hval Heq]]]]].
  - exfalso. exact (isValue_not_step z e0 Hv Hst).
  - destruct pf. subst. exists b. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma EvalsTo_unop_result : forall op E v, EvalsTo (ExpUnOp op E) v -> isValue v -> exists b, v = Bc b.
Proof.
  intros op E v HE Hv.
  destruct (EvalsTo_unop_inv op E v HE Hv) as [z1 [H1 [Hv1 Hfin]]].
  inversion Hfin as [ee | x y z Hstep Htail]; subst.
  - destruct Hv.
  - destruct (Step_unop_src op z1 y Hstep Hv1) as [b Hb]. subst z1.
    inversion Hstep as [ c a a' Hst | c w pf Hval0 | | | | | | | | | | | ]; subst.
    + exfalso. eapply isValue_not_step; [exact I | exact Hst].
    + destruct pf. destruct b; simpl.
      * exists false. symmetry. eapply EvalsTo_value; [exact Htail|exact I].
      * exists true. symmetry. eapply EvalsTo_value; [exact Htail|exact I].
Qed.

Lemma EvalsTo_binop_result : forall op E1 E2 v, EvalsTo (ExpBinOp op E1 E2) v -> isValue v -> exists b, v = Bc b.
Proof.
  intros op E1 E2 v HE Hv.
  destruct (EvalsTo_binop_inv op E1 E2 v HE Hv) as
    [z1 [z2 [H1 [Hv1 [H2 [Hv2 Hfin]]]]]].
  inversion Hfin as [ee | x y z Hstep Htail]; subst.
  - destruct Hv.
  - inversion Hstep as [ | | c e e' e1' Hst | c e e' vv Hval Hst | c v1 v2 pf Hval1 Hval2 | | | | | | | | ]; subst.
    + exfalso. eapply isValue_not_step; [exact Hv1 | exact Hst].
    + exfalso. eapply isValue_not_step; [exact Hv2 | exact Hst].
    + destruct pf; simpl.
      * exists (andb b b0). symmetry. eapply EvalsTo_value; [exact Htail|exact I].
      * exists (orb b b0). symmetry. eapply EvalsTo_value; [exact Htail|exact I].
      * exists (veq v1 v2). symmetry. eapply EvalsTo_value; [exact Htail|exact I].
Qed.

Require Import Relations Decidable.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.

Require Export Definitions.Syntax.

Require Import Forall2.

Require Import Lists.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.Referable.

Require Export Definitions.Names.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Definitions.FJTyping.

Require Import Definitions.Semantics.

Require Import Definitions.SubDenotation.

Inductive WFtype : env -> type -> Prop :=
    | WFBase : forall (g : env) (b : fjtype),
           WFtype g (TRefn b PEmpty)
    | WFRefn : forall (g : env) (b : fjtype) (ps : preds) (nms : names),
          WFtype g (TRefn b PEmpty) -> ps <> PEmpty
              -> (forall (y:vname), ~ Elem y nms
                      -> PIsBool (FCons y (b) (erase_env g)) (unbindP y ps) )
              -> WFtype g (TRefn b ps).

Inductive WFEnv : env -> Prop :=
    | WFEEmpty : WFEnv Empty
    | WFEBind  : forall (g : env) (x : vname) (t : type),
          WFEnv g -> ~ (in_env x g) -> WFtype g t -> WFEnv (Cons x t g).

Reserved Notation "Gamma '|---' x ':' C" (at level 60, x at next level).

Inductive Hastype: env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | TBC   : forall (g:env) (b:bool), Hastype g (Bc b) (tybc b)
  | TIC   : forall (g:env) (m:Z),  Hastype g (Ic m) (tyic m)
  | TUnOP  : forall (g:env) (e:expr) (op: UnOp) t,
        Hastype g e t -> Subtype g t (intype op) -> isLC e -> Hastype g (ExpUnOp op e) (tsubBV e (ty' op))
  | TBinOP : forall (g:env) (e1 e2:expr) (op: BinOp) t t',
        Hastype g e1 t ->
        (Subtype g t (fst (intype2 op))) ->
        Hastype g e2 t'->
        (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 (snd (intype2 op)))) ->
        isLC e1 -> isLC e2 ->
        Hastype g (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 (ty'2 op)))
  | TVar  : forall (g:env) (x:vname) (t:type),
    bound_in x t g -> WFtype g t -> Hastype g (FV x) (self t (FV x))
  | TInvok: forall (g:env) (e1:expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t t' rt C ps ps',
        Hastype g e1 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') ->
        mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        (Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps)) ->
        (Hastype g e2 t') -> (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t)) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
        Hastype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))
  | TInvokI: forall (g:env) (e1:expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t t' rt I ps ps',
        Hastype g e1 (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') ->
        mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        (Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps)) ->
        (Hastype g e2 t') -> (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t)) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
        Hastype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))

Require Import Lists.

Require Import Program.

Require Import Arith.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.

Require Import Definitions.Syntax.

Require Import Definitions.Names.

Require Import Definitions.Semantics.

Inductive SubClass: nomtype -> nomtype -> Prop :=
| SubCRefl : forall b, SubClass b b
| SubCTrans: forall b1 b2 b3, SubClass b1 b2 -> SubClass b2 b3 -> SubClass b1 b3
| SubCInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            SubClass  (TClass C) (TClass D)
| SubIInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is I fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds i,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            nth_error Is i = Some I ->
            SubClass (TClass C) (TInterface I).

Inductive FJSubtype: fjtype -> fjtype -> Prop :=
| SubBAny : forall t, FJSubtype t TAny
| SubBInt : FJSubtype TInt TInt
| SubBBool : FJSubtype TBool TBool
| SubBClass: forall C D, SubClass C D -> FJSubtype (TNom C) (TNom D).

Inductive csub : Set :=
    | CEmpty
    | CCons  (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub).

Fixpoint bindsC (th : csub) : names :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => empty
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => names_add x (bindsC th)
    end.

Definition in_csubst (x : vname) (th : csub) : Prop := Elem x (bindsC th).

Fixpoint bound_inC (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub) : Prop :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty             => False
    | (CCons  y v_y th)  => (x = y /\ v_x = v_y) \/ bound_inC x v_x th
    end.

Fixpoint closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => fv v_x = empty /\ closed th
    end.

Fixpoint loc_closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => isLC v_x /\ loc_closed th
    end.

Fixpoint substitutable (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => isValue v_x /\ substitutable th
    end.

Fixpoint uniqueC (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty         => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => ~ in_csubst x th /\ uniqueC th
    end.

Fixpoint csubst (th : csub) (e : expr) : expr :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => e
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => csubst th (subFV  x v_x e)
    end.

Fixpoint cpsubst (th : csub) (ps : preds) : preds :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => ps
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => cpsubst th (psubFV  x v_x ps)
    end.

Fixpoint ctsubst (th : csub) (t : type) : type :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty           => t
    | (CCons  x v  th) => ctsubst th (tsubFV x v t)
    end.

Fixpoint remove_fromCS (th:csub) (x:vname) : csub :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty          => CEmpty
    | (CCons  y v th) => if x =? y then th else CCons  y v (remove_fromCS th x)
    end.

Fixpoint csubst_env (th0:csub) (g:env) : env :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => g
    | (CCons  z v_z th) => csubst_env th (esubFV  z v_z g)
    end.

Fixpoint CconcatE (th th'0 : csub) : csub :=
    match th'0 with
    | CEmpty          => th
    | (CCons  x t th') => CCons  x t (CconcatE th th')
    end.

Inductive PEvalsTrue : preds -> Prop :=
    | PEEmp  : PEvalsTrue PEmpty
    | PECons : forall (p : expr) (ps : preds),
        EvalsTo p (Bc true) -> PEvalsTrue ps -> PEvalsTrue (PCons p ps).

Inductive Denotes: type -> expr -> Prop :=
| DenotesInt: forall ps i,
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (Ic i) ps) -> Denotes (TRefn TInt ps) (Ic i)
| DenotesBool: forall ps bol,
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (Bc bol) ps) -> Denotes (TRefn TBool ps) (Bc bol)
| DenotesClass: forall ps c es Fs, isValue (ExpNew c es) ->
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (ExpNew c es) ps) ->
    Reffields c Fs -> Forall2 Denotes (map (tsubBV (ExpNew c es)) (map ReffieldType Fs)) (es) ->
    Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) ps) (ExpNew c es)
| DenotesUpcast: forall b1 b ps v,
    Denotes (TRefn b1 ps) v -> FJSubtype b1 b ->
    Denotes (TRefn b ps) v.

Inductive DenotesEnv : env -> csub -> Prop :=
    | DEmp  : DenotesEnv Empty CEmpty
    | DExt  : forall (g:env) (th:csub) (x:vname) (t:type) (v:expr),
        DenotesEnv g th -> ~ in_env x g -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) v
              -> DenotesEnv (Cons x t g) (CCons x v th).

Inductive LImplies : env -> preds -> preds -> Prop :=
    | SImp : forall (g:env) (ps qs : preds),
        (forall (th:csub), DenotesEnv g th -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th ps)
                                           -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th qs) )
            -> LImplies g ps qs.

Definition LEntails g ps:= forall th, DenotesEnv g th -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th ps).

Reserved Notation "Gamma '|-s' T '<::' S" (at level 41).

Inductive Subtype: env-> type -> type -> Prop :=
    | SBase : forall (g:env) (b1 b2:fjtype) (p1:preds) (p2:preds) (nms:names),
    FJSubtype b1 b2 ->
    (forall (y:vname), ~ Elem y nms
                    -> LImplies (Cons y (TRefn b1 PEmpty) g) (unbindP y p1) (unbindP y p2))
        -> Subtype g (TRefn b1 p1) (TRefn b2 p2)

  where "Gamma '|-s' T '<::' S" := (Subtype Gamma T S).

Lemma ctsubst_openT : forall t th y v, LCsubst th -> isValue v -> ~ In y (free t) -> isLCT t ->
  ctsubst (CCons y v th) (openT_at 0 y t) = ctsubst th t.
Proof.
  intros t th y v Hlc Hv Hy Ht. destruct t as [b ps].
  unfold isLCT in Ht. simpl in Ht.
  change (ctsubst th (tsubFV y v (openT_at 0 y (TRefn b ps))) = ctsubst th (TRefn b ps)).
  rewrite tsubFV_openT; auto.
  change (ctsubst th (TRefn b (psubBV_at 1 v ps)) = ctsubst th (TRefn b ps)).
  rewrite ctsubst_TRefn. rewrite ctsubst_TRefn.
  assert (Hps : psubBV_at 1 v ps = ps).
  { apply psubBV_at_lc. unfold isLCP_at. exact Ht. }
  rewrite Hps. reflexivity.
Qed.

  ).

  (exists Ds D0 ps', mtype(m, C) = ps' ~> Ds ~> D0 /\
  (Subtype Empty (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') /\
  subtype_under (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) t Ds /\

  match e with

| isCpt_Or   : forall b1 b2, isCompat2 Or  (Bc b1) (Bc b2)
| isCpt_Eq  : forall v1 v2, isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> isCompat2 Eq v1 v2.

Fixpoint veq v1 v2 :=
    match v1, v2 with
    | (Ic n1), (Ic n2) => Z.eqb n1 n2
    | (Bc n1), (Bc n2) => Bool.eqb n1 n2
    | (ExpNew c1 es1), (ExpNew c2 es2) => andb (c1 =? c2) ((fix ff es1' es2' :=
                                                    match es1' with

                                                    | e1 :: es1'' => (match es2' with | nil => false | e2:: es2'' => andb (veq e1 e2) (ff es1'' es2'') end)
                                                    end) es1 es2)
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Definition udelta (c : UnOp) (v : expr) (pf : isCompat c v) : expr :=
  match pf with
  | isCpt_Not b    => match b with

                      | false => Bc true
                      end
  end.

  match v with

  match pf with

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia ZArith Bool.
Require Import ListSet RFJ.Lists RFJ.Utils.Referable Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Definitions.Syntax Definitions.Semantics Definitions.Typing
  Definitions.CTSanity Definitions.SubDenotation Definitions.FJTyping.
Require Import devtest8.

Inductive EvalsToN : nat -> expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| EvN_refl : forall e, EvalsToN 0 e e
| EvN_step : forall n e1 e2 e3, Step e1 e2 -> EvalsToN n e2 e3 -> EvalsToN (S n) e1 e3.

Lemma EvN_EvalsTo : forall n e v, EvalsToN n e v -> EvalsTo e v.
Proof.
  intros n e v H. induction H as [e | n e1 e2 e3 Hstep Htail IH].
  - apply Refl.
  - eapply AddStep; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma EvalsTo_EvN : forall e v, EvalsTo e v -> exists n, EvalsToN n e v.
Proof.
  intros e v H. induction H as [e | e1 e2 e3 Hstep Htail IH].
  - exists 0. apply EvN_refl.
  - destruct IH as [n Hn]. exists (S n). eapply EvN_step; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma EvN_value_eq : forall n e v, EvalsToN n e v -> isValue e -> v = e.
Proof.
  intros n e v H. induction H as [e | n e1 e2 e3 Hstep Htail IH]; intros Hv.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply isValue_not_step; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma EvN_trans : forall n a b, EvalsToN n a b -> forall m c, EvalsToN m b c -> EvalsToN (n+m) a c.
Proof.
  intros n a b H. induction H as [a | n a b c Hstep Htail IH]; intros m d Hmd.
  - simpl. exact Hmd.
  - simpl. eapply EvN_step; [exact Hstep | apply IH; exact Hmd].
Qed.

Lemma EvN_unop_decomp : forall n op e v, EvalsToN n (ExpUnOp op e) v -> isValue v ->
  exists n1 n2 w r, EvalsToN n1 e w /\ isValue w /\
    Step (ExpUnOp op w) r /\ EvalsToN n2 r v /\ n = n1 + S n2.
Proof.
  intros n op e v H. remember (ExpUnOp op e) as X eqn:EX. revert op e EX.
  induction H as [a | n' a b c Hstep Htail IH]; intros op0 e0 EX Hv.
  - subst a. cbn in Hv. destruct Hv.
  - subst a.
    destruct (Step_UnOp_inv op0 e0 b Hstep) as [[e1 [Hst Heq]] | [w [pf [He [Hval Heq]]]]].
    + subst b.
      destruct (IH op0 e1 eq_refl Hv) as [n1 [n2 [w [r [Hev [Hw [Hstep2 [Hrv Hn]]]]]]]].

      split; [apply EvN_refl|split; [exact Hval|split; [apply EUnOp2; exact Hval|split; [exact Htail|lia]]]].
Qed.
EOF

Lemma EvN_value_steps : forall n e v, EvalsToN n e v -> isValue e -> n = 0.

Lemma EvN_binop_decomp : forall n op e1 e2 v,
  EvalsToN n (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) v -> isValue v ->
  exists n1 n2 n3 w1 w2 r, EvalsToN n1 e1 w1 /\ isValue w1 /\
    EvalsToN n2 e2 w2 /\ isValue w2 /\
    Step (ExpBinOp op w1 w2) r /\ EvalsToN n3 r v /\ n = n1 + n2 + 1 + n3.
Proof.
  intros n op e1 e2 v H. remember (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) as X eqn:EX.
  revert op e1 e2 EX.
  induction H as [a | n' a b c Hstep Htail IH]; intros op0 e0 e2' EX Hv.
  - subst a. cbn in Hv. destruct Hv.
  - subst a.
    destruct (Step_BinOp_inv op0 e0 e2' b Hstep) as
      [[e1' [Hst Heq]] | [[e2'' [Hval [Hst Heq]]] | [pf [Hval1 [Hval2 Heq]]]]].
    + subst b.
      destruct (IH op0 e1' e2' eq_refl Hv) as
        [n1 [n2 [n3 [w1 [w2 [r [H1 [Hw1 [H2 [Hw2 [Hstep2 [Hrv Hn]]]]]]]]]]]].
      exists (S n1), n2, n3, w1, w2, r.
      split; [|split; [exact Hw1|split; [exact H2|split; [exact Hw2|split; [exact Hstep2|split; [exact Hrv|lia]]]]]]].
      eapply EvN_step; eauto.
    + subst b.
      destruct (IH op0 e0 e2'' eq_refl Hv) as

      assert (Hn1 : n1 = 0) by (eapply EvN_value_steps; eauto).
      assert (Hw1eq : w1 = e0) by (eapply EvN_value_eq; eauto).
      subst n1. subst w1.
      exists 0, (S n2), n3, e0, w2, r.
      split; [apply EvN_refl|split; [exact Hval|split; [|split; [exact Hw2|split; [exact Hstep2|split; [exact Hrv|lia]]]]]].
      * eapply EvN_step; eauto.

      apply EBinOp3 with (pf := pf); auto.

Lemma EvN_let_decomp : forall n e1 e2 v,

    EvalsToN n1 e (ExpNew C es) /\ isValue (ExpNew C es) /\

    destruct (Step_Field_inv e0 f0 b Hstep) as

       [C [Fs [es [fi [ei [i [Heq [HFs [HnF [Hrf [HnE [HvalNew Hz]]]]]]]]]]]]].

Inductive HastypeD : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

| D_TIC : forall g n, HastypeD g (Ic n) (tyic n)

| D_TVar : forall g x t, bound_in x t g -> WFtype g t -> HastypeD g (FV x) (self t (FV x))
| D_TInvok : forall g e1 e2 m t t' rt C ps ps',

    Hastype g e2 t' -> Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
    HastypeD g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))

    Hastype g e (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) -> Reffields C Fs -> nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
    ref fi = f -> HastypeD g (ExpFieldAccess e f) (self (tsubBV e (ReffieldType fi)) (ExpFieldAccess e f))

Inductive HastypeD : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
| D_TBC : forall g b, HastypeD g (Bc b) (tybc b)
| D_TIC : forall g n, HastypeD g (Ic n) (tyic n)
| D_TUnOP : forall g e op t, Hastype g e t -> Subtype g t (intype op) -> isLC e ->
    HastypeD g (ExpUnOp op e) (tsubBV e (ty' op))
| D_TBinOP : forall g e1 e2 op t t', Hastype g e1 t -> Subtype g t (fst (intype2 op)) ->
    Hastype g e2 t' -> Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 (snd (intype2 op))) ->
    isLC e1 -> isLC e2 -> HastypeD g (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 (ty'2 op)))
| D_TVar : forall g x t, bound_in x t g -> WFtype g t -> HastypeD g (FV x) (self t (FV x))
| D_TInvok : forall g e1 e2 m t t' rt C ps ps',
    Hastype g e1 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') -> mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
    Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) ->
    Hastype g e2 t' -> Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
    HastypeD g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))
| D_TInvokI : forall g e1 e2 m t t' rt I ps ps',
    Hastype g e1 (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') -> mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
    Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps) ->
    Hastype g e2 t' -> Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
    HastypeD g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))
| D_TField : forall g e f C Fs i fi ps, isLC e ->
    Hastype g e (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) -> Reffields C Fs -> nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
    ref fi = f -> HastypeD g (ExpFieldAccess e f) (self (tsubBV e (ReffieldType fi)) (ExpFieldAccess e f))
| D_TNew : forall g es Ts C Fs Us fs, Us = map ReffieldType Fs -> fs = map ref Fs ->
    Forall isLC es -> Reffields C Fs -> Forall2 (Hastype g) es Ts ->
    Forall2 (Subtype g) Ts (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C es)) Us) ->
    HastypeD g (ExpNew C es) (self (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) PEmpty) (ExpNew C es))
| D_TLet : forall g e_x b e b' nms, WFtype g b' -> Hastype g e_x b ->

Fixpoint subBV_at (j : index) (v : expr)  (e : expr) {struct e} : expr :=
  match e with
  | (Bc b)             => Bc b
  | (Ic n)             => Ic n
  | (BV i)             => if j =? i then v else BV i
  | (FV x)             => FV x
  | (ExpUnOp op e)         => ExpUnOp op (subBV_at j v e)
  | (ExpBinOp op e e')         => ExpBinOp op (subBV_at j v e)  (subBV_at j v e')
  | (ExpMethodInvoc e m e')         => ExpMethodInvoc (subBV_at j v e) m (subBV_at j v e')
  | (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) => ExpFieldAccess (subBV_at j v e1) f
  | (ExpNew c es) => ExpNew c ((fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => nil | e::es''=> (subBV_at j v e) :: (f es'') end) es)
  | (ExpLet ex e)         => ExpLet   (subBV_at j v ex) (subBV_at (j+1) v e)
  end
with tsubBV_at (j : index) (v_x : expr) (t0 : type)  {struct t0} : type :=
    match t0 with
    | (TRefn b ps)    => TRefn b (psubBV_at (j+1) v_x ps)
    end

with psubBV_at (j : index) (v_x : expr) (ps0 : preds)  {struct ps0} : preds  :=
    match ps0 with
    | PEmpty       => PEmpty
    | (PCons p ps) => PCons (subBV_at j v_x p) (psubBV_at j v_x ps)

  - simpl; auto.

## Verified this turn

`/tmp` was wiped again; I restored the durable snapshots (`devtest8_backup.v`, `fuel_backup2.v`) from `/mnt`, rebuilt the base `.vo`, and extended the fuel development.

New, compiling lemmas in `/tmp/fuel.v` (608 lines, md5 `a11311b3…`, backed up as `/mnt/.../fuel_backup3.v`):

- `sem_all m` — well-founded induction on fuel via `lt_wf_rect`, reducing the uniform statement to `sem_inner m` with the smaller-fuel hypothesis supplied by the induction hypothesis.
- `sem_evals` — transforms an ordinary `EvalsTo` evaluation into an `EvalsToN` one (`EvalsTo_EvN`) and applies `sem_all`, yielding exactly the statement of the original `sem_typing`:
  `Hastype g e t -> DenotesEnv g th -> EvalsTo (csubst th e) v -> isValue v -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) v`.

Consequently, the entire remaining proof of the semantic typing theorem is now reduced to the three `admit`ted `sem_inner` cases: **Invok, Field, New**. Seven of ten expression cases are fully proved (Bc, Ic, BV, FV, UnOp, BinOp, Let), and the assembly (`sem_all`, `sem_evals`) is verified.

## Remaining work — precise blockers

- **Field / New** require the field-type semantics: for a field declaration `fi` from `Reffields C Fs` we need `free (ReffieldType fi) = empty` and a coverage property (`bvCover 1`) for its predicates, derived from `cok`/`CType_OK`/`FType_OK`/`wf_under` and `HasFJtype_isLC`. Then the denotation supplied by `Subtype_sound` uses the *source* receiver expression `ExpNew C es`, while `DenotesClass` requires the *evaluated* receiver `ExpNew C vs`. Transferring between them needs an evaluation/substitution simulation in the **source → value** direction, which is the opposite orientation from the existing `sim_subBV` and requires a new argument; this is the main remaining semantic obstacle.
- **Invok** additionally needs method-body instantiation from `MType_OK`, opening/substitution commutation, a semantic `DenotesEnv` construction, and `override`/`subtype_under` transfer; **TInvokI** needs `Class_implemented` plus inversion of `DenotesUpcast` to recover the dynamic class.
- Finally, `logical_soundness` needs the predicate transfer from the evaluated value back to `psubBV e ps` in `PEvalsTrue`, using `cpsubst_psubBV0` and an evaluation simulation (the same orientation issue), then assembly into `Task.v` with all `Admitted`/`admit` removed.

No proof escapes have been added; all new work is ordinary Rocq. The honest assessment remains that the three class-table-dependent cases are a substantial remaining formalization, and `Task.v` cannot yet be replaced by a complete, admit-free file.

content.thinking:
`rewrite Hr in *` rewrote Ht1 from udelta pf1 to udelta pf2, but our Hsmall call still expects Ht1 at udelta pf1; the term is now at pf2. Simplest: don't rewrite Hr in *; instead rewrite only in Ht2 (both tails must have the same r). We want Ht1 : EvalsToN n2 (udelta pf1) v1 and Ht2 : EvalsToN n2' (udelta pf2) v2; rewrite Hr in Ht2 (or <-) to align to pf1, then call Hsmall with r=udelta pf1. So replace `rewrite Hr in *.` with `rewrite Hr in Ht2.`? Hr : pf1-expr = pf2-expr; Ht2 has pf2; `rewrite <- Hr in Ht2` turns pf2→pf1. Use `rewrite <- Hr in Ht2.` Then Ht2 : EvalsToN n2' (udelta pf1) v2; call Hsmall ... (udelta pf1) v1 Ht1 n2' v2 Ht2. ✓.
Similarly BinOp's `rewrite Hr in *.` → `rewrite <- Hr in Ht2.` (Hr : bdelta pf1 = bdelta pf2; Ht2 has pf2; rewrite <- turns to pf1).
Patch.

content.thinking:
The uniqueness proof for Bc, Ic, BV, FV, UnOp, BinOp compiles (with Invok/Field/New/Let admitted and unique_inner Admitted). Great progress on the confluence architecture.

Now the remaining uniqueness cases: Field, New, Invok, Let. Let me implement Let and Field next (New and Invok are harder but let's see).

Let uniqueness:
First eval at F: rewrite? The expression is ExpLet e1 e2. EvN_let_decomp F e1 e2 v1 H1 Hv1 → nx n2 vx, Hx: EvalsToN nx e1 vx, Hvx, Hbody: EvalsToN n2 (subBV_at 0 vx e2) v1, Hn: F = nx+1+n2.
Second eval at m: nx' n2' vx', Hx', Hvx', Hbody': EvalsToN n2' (subBV vx' e2) v2, Hn2.
uniqueness of vx=vx' via expression IH/Hsmall on e1 (subterm; first fuel nx < F always since F=nx+1+n2, so use Hsmall nx (lia) e1 vx Hx n' vx' Hx' Hvx Hvx'). Actually nx<F; expression IH at F could also be used if nx=F impossible. Use Hsmall.
Then subst vx'; the body term is the same (subBV vx e2). Tails: first fuel n2 < F; use Hsmall n2 (lia) (subBV vx e2) v1 Hbody n2' v2 Hbody' Hv1 Hv2.
Note evals for the body's source expression: uniqueness is about the *same expression* subBV vx e2; Hsmall quantifies any expression, so fine.
So Let is easy.

Field uniqueness:
First: EvN_field_decomp F e f v1 H1 Hv1 → n1 C1 Fs1 es1 fi1 ei1 i1, Hrec1: EvalsToN n1 e (ExpNew C1 es1), Hval1, HFs1, HnF1, Href1, HnE1, Hv1eq: v1=ei1, Hn1: F=n1+1.
Second: similarly with primes.
uniqueness of receiver values: ExpNew C1 es1 = ExpNew C2 es2 via expression IH/Hsmall on e with first fuel n1 (n1<F since F=n1+1): strong Hsmall n1 (lia) e (ExpNew C1 es1) Hrec1 m (ExpNew C2 es2) Hrec2 Hval1 Hval2. (Second fuel m; use the second decomposition's receiver eval at fuel n1'? Hrec2's fuel is n1'; use n1'.)
After inject: C1=C2 and es1=es2. Use `injection HrecEq as HC Hes; subst`.
Then v1=ei1, v2=ei2. Need ei1=ei2. Both decompositions have Reffields C1 Fs1 and C1 Fs2 (after C2=C1); Reffields_det gives Fs1=Fs2. The field name: Href1 : ref fi1 = f; Href2 : ref fi2 = f, so ref fi1 = ref fi2. nth positions i1,i2 with HnF1, HnF2 into the same Fs; nth_error_ref_unique (NoDup refs Fs from Reffields_NoDup) gives i1=i2 and fi1=fi2. Then nth_error es1 i1 = Some ei1 and nth_error es1 i2 = Some ei2 (HnE2 after es2=es1 and i2=i1) → ei1=ei2. 
Implementation:
```
    assert (Hreq : ExpNew C1 es1 = ExpNew C2 es2).
    { exact (Hsmall n1 (lia) e (ExpNew C1 es1) Hrec1 n1' (ExpNew C2 es2) Hrec2 Hval1 Hval2). }
    injection Hreq as HC Hes. subst C2. subst es2.
    subst v1. subst v2.
    assert (HFs : Fs1 = Fs2) by (eapply Reffields_det; eauto).
    subst Fs2.
    assert (Hrefeq : ref fi1 = ref fi2) by (rewrite Href1; exact Href2).
    destruct (nth_error_ref_unique Fs1 i1 fi1 i2 fi2 (Reffields_NoDup C1 Fs1 HFs1) HnF1 HnF2 Hrefeq) as [Hi Hfi].
    subst i2. subst fi2.
    rewrite HnE1 in HnE2. injection HnE2 as Hei. subst ei2.
    reflexivity.
```
Careful: `subst C2` might fail if C2 appears in Hrec2 etc.; injection Hreq gives HC : C1=C2 or C2=C1? injection of ExpNew C1 es1 = ExpNew C2 es2 gives C1 = C2 and es1=es2; `subst C2` replaces C2 by C1 (orientation C1=C2). Fine. `subst es2`.
Also `subst v1`/`subst v2`: Hv1eq : v1 = ei1; Hv2eq : v2 = ei2. After subst, goal ei1 = ei2? The final goal is v1=v2; rewriting v1,v2 gives ei1=ei2. Then after HnE equality, reflexivity.
The second receiver eval fuel: use n1' (from the second decomposition) and n1' < F? The second decomposition's Hn2 gives m = n1'+1, so n1' < m, but for Hsmall the *first* fuel is n1 < F and the second is n1' arbitrary—no bound needed on the second in Hsmall's statement (forall m). ✓. So pass n1' as the second fuel.

Field decomposition's bound: Hn1 : F = n1 + 1 → n1 < F by lia.

Invok uniqueness:
First: EvN_invok_decomp F e1 m e2 v1 H1 Hv1 → na1 na2 nb1 C1 es1 vb1 body1, Hrec1: EvalsToN na1 e1 (ExpNew C1 es1), HvalN1, Harg1: EvalsToN na2 e2 vb1, Hvb1, Hbodyrel1: m_body mm C1 body1, Hbodyev1: EvalsToN nb1 bodyinst1 v1, Hn1: F = na1+na2+1+nb1.
Second analogous.
Uniqueness receiver: Hsmall na1 (lia: na1<F) e1 (ExpNew C1 es1) Hrec1 na1' (ExpNew C2 es2) Hrec2 HvalN1 HvalN2 → equality; inject C1=C2, es1=es2.
Uniqueness arg: Hsmall na2? Is na2 < F? F = na1+na2+1+nb1, so na2 < F. Pass first fuel na2, second na2'. Get vb1=vb2.
Then body terms: m_body mm C1 body1 and m_body mm C1 body2 (after C2=C1); m_body_det gives body1=body2. After subst es2, vb2, body2, the bodyinst terms are the same. Then tails: first fuel nb1 < F (nb1 < F by Hn1), use Hsmall nb1 (lia) bodyinst1 v1 Hbodyev1 nb1' v2 Hbodyev2 Hv1 Hv2.
Implementation details: the decomposition exists order: n1 n2 nb C es vb body. Pattern.
`subBV_at 1 (ExpNew C es) (subBV vb body)` terms; after subst es2 (es1=es2) and vb2 and body2, the two instantiated bodies align. Need care: es2 is a list; `subst es2` replaces es2 with es1 (from injection es1=es2 orientation). Then Hrec2's type updated. vb2 substitution from vb1=vb2. body2 from body_det body1=body2.
Then Hsmall nb1 (lia) bodyinst1 v1 Hbodyev1 nb1' v2 Hbodyev2.
The second body eval Hbodyev2 has the bodyinst2 term; after substitutions it becomes bodyinst1.
This should work.

New uniqueness: the hard list case. Let me handle it after Field/Invok/Let.

Let me implement Let, Field, Invok now in uniq.v, replacing the admits. Then New.

Field pattern order from EvN_field_decomp: exists n1 C Fs es fi ei i, EvalsToN n1 e (ExpNew C es) /\ isValue (ExpNew C es) /\ Reffields C Fs /\ nth_error Fs i=Some fi /\ ref fi=f /\ nth_error es i=Some ei /\ v=ei /\ n=n1+1.
Destruct as [n1 [C1 [Fs1 [es1 [fi1 [ei1 [i1 [Hrec1 [Hval1 [HFs1 [HnF1 [Href1 [HnE1 [Hv1eq Hn1]]]]]]]]]]]]].

Invok pattern: [n1 [n2 [nb [C [es [vb [body [Hrec [HvalN [Harg [Hvb [Hbodyrel [Hbodyev Hn]]]]]]]]]]]]].

Let me patch all three.

Lemma subBV_many_UnOp : forall ws o e,
  subBV_many ws (ExpUnOp o e) = ExpUnOp o (subBV_many ws e).
Proof.
  induction ws as [|w ws IH]; intros o e.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. change (subBV_many ws (ExpUnOp o (subBV_at (length ws) w e))
                = ExpUnOp o (subBV_many (w::ws) e)).
    rewrite (IH o (subBV_at (length ws) w e)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subBV_many_BinOp : forall ws o e1 e2,
  subBV_many ws (ExpBinOp o e1 e2) = ExpBinOp o (subBV_many ws e1) (subBV_many ws e2).
Proof.
  induction ws as [|w ws IH]; intros o e1 e2.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. change (subBV_many ws
       (ExpBinOp o (subBV_at (length ws) w e1) (subBV_at (length ws) w e2))
       = ExpBinOp o (subBV_many (w::ws) e1) (subBV_many (w::ws) e2)).
    rewrite (IH o (subBV_at (length ws) w e1) (subBV_at (length ws) w e2)).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subBV_many_Invok : forall ws e1 m e2,
  subBV_many ws (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2)
  = ExpMethodInvoc (subBV_many ws e1) m (subBV_many ws e2).
Proof.
  induction ws as [|w ws IH]; intros e1 m e2.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. change (subBV_many ws
       (ExpMethodInvoc (subBV_at (length ws) w e1) m (subBV_at (length ws) w e2))
       = ExpMethodInvoc (subBV_many (w::ws) e1) m (subBV_many (w::ws) e2)).
    rewrite (IH (subBV_at (length ws) w e1) m (subBV_at (length ws) w e2)).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subBV_many_Field : forall ws e f,
  subBV_many ws (ExpFieldAccess e f) = ExpFieldAccess (subBV_many ws e) f.
Proof.
  induction ws as [|w ws IH]; intros e f.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. change (subBV_many ws (ExpFieldAccess (subBV_at (length ws) w e) f)
                = ExpFieldAccess (subBV_many (w::ws) e) f).
    rewrite (IH (subBV_at (length ws) w e) f). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subBV_many_New : forall ws C l,
  subBV_many ws (ExpNew C l) = ExpNew C (map (subBV_many ws) l).
Proof.
  induction ws as [|w ws IH]; intros C l.
  - simpl. f_equal. symmetry. apply map_id.
  - simpl. change (subBV_many ws (ExpNew C (map (subBV_at (length ws) w) l))

    rewrite (IH C (map (subBV_at (length ws) w) l)).
    f_equal. rewrite map_map. apply map_ext. intro x. reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Relations Decidable.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.

Require Export Definitions.Syntax.

Require Import Forall2.

Require Import Lists.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.Referable.

Require Export Definitions.Names.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Definitions.FJTyping.

Require Import Definitions.Semantics.

Require Import Lists.ListSet.

Require Import Definitions.SubDenotation.

Require Import Definitions.Typing.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Lia.

Definition override (m: MethodName) (C: ClassName) (D: ClassName) (ps: preds) (Cs: type) (C0: type) :=
  (forall Ds D0 ps', mtype(m, D) = ps' ~> Ds ~> D0 ->
  (Subtype Empty (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) /\
  subtype_under (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') Ds Cs /\
  subtype_under2 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') Ds C0 D0)
  ).

Definition implement (C: ClassName) (m: MethodName) (t0: type) (ps: preds) (t: type) :=
  (exists Ds D0 ps', mtype(m, C) = ps' ~> Ds ~> D0 /\
  (Subtype Empty (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') /\
  subtype_under (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) t Ds /\
  subtype_under2 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) t D0 t0)
  ).

Inductive MType_OK : ClassName -> MethodDefn -> Prop :=
| WF_Method : forall ps rt t e (C:ClassName) D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds m,
          find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
          find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
          override m C D ps t rt->
          (WFtype Empty (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps)) ->
          wf_under (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) t ->
          wf_under2 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) t rt ->
          (forall y y', y <> y' -> Hastype (Cons y' (openT_at 0 y t) (Cons y (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) Empty)) (open_at 1 y (open_at 0 y' e)) (openT_at 1 y (openT_at 0 y' rt))) ->
          (fv e = empty) ->
          (free t = empty) -> (free rt = empty) ->
          MType_OK C (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e).

Inductive FType_OK : ClassName -> RefFieldDecl -> Prop :=
| WF_Field : forall C t f,
          free t = empty ->
          wf_under (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) PEmpty) t ->
          FType_OK C (RefFDecl t f).

Inductive Class_implemented: ClassName -> InterfaceName -> Prop :=
| CI: forall C I iMs noDupiMds,
  find I RefIT = Some (RefIDecl I iMs noDupiMds) ->
  (forall im irt ips it,
  find im iMs = Some (MDecl irt im ips it) ->
  implement C im irt ips it) ->
  Class_implemented C I.

Inductive CType_OK: RefClassDecl -> Prop :=
| T_Class : forall C D Fs noDupfs Is K Ms noDupMds fdecl ,
          K = KDecl C (Fs ++ fdecl) (refs fdecl) (zipWith Assgnmt (map (ExpFieldAccess (BV 0)) (refs Fs)) (map FV (refs Fs))) ->
          Reffields D fdecl ->
          NoDup (refs (fdecl ++ Fs)) ->
          Forall (MType_OK C) (Ms) ->
          Forall (FType_OK C) (Fs) ->
          find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds) ->
          (forall i I,
          nth_error Is i = Some I ->
          Class_implemented C I) ->



          CType_OK (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds).

Inductive MType_OK_I : ClassName -> MethodDecl -> Prop :=
| WF_MethodI : forall ps rt t (C:InterfaceName) m,
          (WFtype Empty (TRefn (TNom (TInterface C)) ps)) ->
          wf_under (TRefn (TNom (TInterface C)) ps) t ->
          wf_under2 (TRefn (TNom (TInterface C)) ps) t rt ->
          (free t = empty) -> (free rt = empty) ->
          MType_OK_I C (MDecl rt m ps t).

Inductive IType_OK: RefInterfaceDecl -> Prop :=
| T_ClassI : forall I iMs noDupiMds ,
          Forall (MType_OK_I I) (iMs) ->
          find I RefIT = Some (RefIDecl I iMs noDupiMds) ->
          IType_OK (RefIDecl I iMs noDupiMds).

Parameter cok: forall C D Fs noDupfs K Is Ms noDupMds,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds) ->
            CType_OK (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds).

Require Import Relations Decidable.

Require Import RFJ.Lists.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.Referable.

Require Import Forall2.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Bool.

Require Export Definitions.Syntax.

Require Export Definitions.Names.

Inductive isCompat : UnOp -> expr -> Set :=
    | isCpt_Not  : forall b, isCompat Not (Bc b).

Inductive isCompat2 : BinOp -> expr -> expr -> Set :=
| isCpt_And  : forall b1 b2, isCompat2 And (Bc b1) (Bc b2)
| isCpt_Or   : forall b1 b2, isCompat2 Or  (Bc b1) (Bc b2)
| isCpt_Eq  : forall v1 v2, isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> isCompat2 Eq v1 v2.

Fixpoint veq v1 v2 :=
    match v1, v2 with
    | (Ic n1), (Ic n2) => Z.eqb n1 n2
    | (Bc n1), (Bc n2) => Bool.eqb n1 n2
    | (ExpNew c1 es1), (ExpNew c2 es2) => andb (c1 =? c2) ((fix ff es1' es2' :=
                                                    match es1' with
                                                    | nil => (match es2' with | nil => true | e2:: es2'' => false end)
                                                    | e1 :: es1'' => (match es2' with | nil => false | e2:: es2'' => andb (veq e1 e2) (ff es1'' es2'') end)
                                                    end) es1 es2)
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Definition udelta (c : UnOp) (v : expr) (pf : isCompat c v) : expr :=
  match pf with
  | isCpt_Not b    => match b with
                      | true  => Bc false
                      | false => Bc true
                      end
  end.

Definition udelta' (c : UnOp) (v : expr) : option expr :=
  match v with
  |(Bc b) => match b with
            | true  => Some (Bc false)
            | false => Some (Bc true)
            end
  | _     => None
  end.

Definition bdelta (c : BinOp) (v1 : expr) (v2 : expr) (pf : isCompat2 c v1 v2) : expr :=
  match pf with
  | isCpt_And b1 b2   => Bc (andb b1 b2)
  | isCpt_Or b1 b2    => Bc (orb b1 b2)
  | isCpt_Eq v1 v2 p1 p2 => Bc (veq v1 v2)

  end.

Definition bdelta' (c : BinOp) (v1 : expr) (v2 : expr) : option expr :=
  match c, v1, v2 with
  | And      , (Bc b1), (Bc b2) => Some  (Bc (andb b1 b2))
  | Or       , (Bc b1), (Bc b2) => Some  (Bc (orb b1 b2))
  | Eq       , _, _             => Some (Bc (veq v1 v2))
  | _        , _, _         => None
  end.

Inductive Reffields : ClassName -> [RefFieldDecl] -> Prop :=
| RefF_Obj : Reffields Object nil
| RefF_Decl : forall C D Is fs  noDupfs K mds noDupMds fs',
    find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds) ->
    Reffields D fs' ->
    NoDup (refs (fs' ++ fs)) ->
    Reffields C (fs'++fs).

Reserved Notation "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type: MethodName -> ClassName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
  | mty_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
              mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt
  | mty_no_override: forall ps C D Is m rt t Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds) ->
              find m Ms = None ->
              mtype(m, D) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
              mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt
  where "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
        := (m_type m D ps cs c0).

Reserved Notation "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type_i: MethodName -> InterfaceName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
| mty_ok_i : forall I Ms m rt t ps noDupMds,
            find I RefIT = Some (RefIDecl I Ms noDupMds)->
            find m Ms = Some (MDecl rt m ps t) ->
            mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt
where "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
      := (m_type_i m I ps cs c0).

Inductive m_body: MethodName -> ClassName -> expr -> Prop:=
  | mbdy_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
              m_body m C e
  | mbdy_no_override: forall C D Is m e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = None ->
              m_body m D e ->
              m_body m C e.

Notation "'mbody(' m ',' D ')' '=' e" := (m_body m D e) (at level 40).

Reserved Notation "e '~~>' e1" (at level 60).

Inductive Step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| EUnOp1 : forall (c:UnOp) (e e': expr) ,
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpUnOp c e) (ExpUnOp c e')
| EUnOp2 : forall (c:UnOp) (w : expr) (pf : isCompat c w),
      isValue w -> Step (ExpUnOp c w) (udelta c w pf)
| EBinOp1 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' e1 : expr),
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c e e1) (ExpBinOp c e' e1)
| EBinOp2 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' v : expr),
      isValue v -> Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c v e) (ExpBinOp c v e')
| EBinOp3 : forall (c:BinOp) (v1 v2: expr) (pf : isCompat2 c v1 v2),
      isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> Step (ExpBinOp c v1 v2) (bdelta c v1 v2 pf)
| Refc_Invok1: forall m e1 e2 e1',
      e1 ~~> e1' ->
      ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2 ~~> ExpMethodInvoc e1' m e2
| Refc_Invok2: forall m v e e',
    isValue v -> e ~~> e' ->
    ExpMethodInvoc v m e ~~> ExpMethodInvoc v m e'
| Refc_Invok3: forall C e m v es,
    mbody(m, C) = e -> isValue v -> isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
    ExpMethodInvoc (ExpNew C es) m v ~~> (subBV_at 1 (ExpNew C es) (subBV v e))
| Refc_Field : forall C Fs es fi ei i,
      Reffields C Fs ->
      nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei->
      isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
      ExpFieldAccess (ExpNew C es) (ref fi) ~~> ei
| RefRC_Field : forall e0 e0' f,
      e0 ~~> e0' ->
      ExpFieldAccess e0 f ~~> ExpFieldAccess e0' f
| RefRC_New_Arg : forall C ei' es es' ei i,
      Step ei ei' ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei ->
      nth_error es' i = Some ei' ->
      (forall j, j <> i -> nth_error es j = nth_error es' j) ->
      length es = length es' ->
      ExpNew C es ~~> ExpNew C es'
| ELet  : forall (e_x e_x' e : expr),
      Step e_x e_x' -> Step (ExpLet e_x e) (ExpLet e_x' e)
| ELetV : forall (v : expr) (e : expr),
      isValue v -> Step (ExpLet v e) (subBV v e)
  where "e '~~>' e1" := (Step e e1).

Inductive EvalsTo : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Refl     : forall (e : expr),  EvalsTo e e
  | AddStep  : forall (e1 e2 e3 : expr),
        Step e1 e2 -> EvalsTo e2 e3 -> EvalsTo e1 e3.

Inductive Reffields : ClassName -> [RefFieldDecl] -> Prop :=
| RefF_Obj : Reffields Object nil
| RefF_Decl : forall C D Is fs  noDupfs K mds noDupMds fs',
    find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds) ->
    Reffields D fs' ->
    NoDup (refs (fs' ++ fs)) ->
    Reffields C (fs'++fs).

Reserved Notation "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type: MethodName -> ClassName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
  | mty_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->

              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds) ->
              find m Ms = None ->
              mtype(m, D) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
              mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt
  where "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
        := (m_type m D ps cs c0).

Reserved Notation "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type_i: MethodName -> InterfaceName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
| mty_ok_i : forall I Ms m rt t ps noDupMds,
            find I RefIT = Some (RefIDecl I Ms noDupMds)->
            find m Ms = Some (MDecl rt m ps t) ->
            mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt
where "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
      := (m_type_i m I ps cs c0).

Inductive m_body: MethodName -> ClassName -> expr -> Prop:=
  | mbdy_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
              m_body m C e
  | mbdy_no_override: forall C D Is m e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = None ->
              m_body m D e ->
              m_body m C e.

Notation "'mbody(' m ',' D ')' '=' e" := (m_body m D e) (at level 40).

Reserved Notation "e '~~>' e1" (at level 60).

Inductive Step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| EUnOp1 : forall (c:UnOp) (e e': expr) ,
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpUnOp c e) (ExpUnOp c e')
| EUnOp2 : forall (c:UnOp) (w : expr) (pf : isCompat c w),
      isValue w -> Step (ExpUnOp c w) (udelta c w pf)
| EBinOp1 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' e1 : expr),
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c e e1) (ExpBinOp c e' e1)
| EBinOp2 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' v : expr),
      isValue v -> Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c v e) (ExpBinOp c v e')
| EBinOp3 : forall (c:BinOp) (v1 v2: expr) (pf : isCompat2 c v1 v2),
      isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> Step (ExpBinOp c v1 v2) (bdelta c v1 v2 pf)
| Refc_Invok1: forall m e1 e2 e1',
      e1 ~~> e1' ->
      ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2 ~~> ExpMethodInvoc e1' m e2
| Refc_Invok2: forall m v e e',
    isValue v -> e ~~> e' ->
    ExpMethodInvoc v m e ~~> ExpMethodInvoc v m e'
| Refc_Invok3: forall C e m v es,
    mbody(m, C) = e -> isValue v -> isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
    ExpMethodInvoc (ExpNew C es) m v ~~> (subBV_at 1 (ExpNew C es) (subBV v e))
| Refc_Field : forall C Fs es fi ei i,
      Reffields C Fs ->
      nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei->
      isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
      ExpFieldAccess (ExpNew C es) (ref fi) ~~> ei
| RefRC_Field : forall e0 e0' f,
      e0 ~~> e0' ->
      ExpFieldAccess e0 f ~~> ExpFieldAccess e0' f
| RefRC_New_Arg : forall C ei' es es' ei i,
      Step ei ei' ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei ->
      nth_error es' i = Some ei' ->
      (forall j, j <> i -> nth_error es j = nth_error es' j) ->
      length es = length es' ->
      ExpNew C es ~~> ExpNew C es'
| ELet  : forall (e_x e_x' e : expr),
      Step e_x e_x' -> Step (ExpLet e_x e) (ExpLet e_x' e)
| ELetV : forall (v : expr) (e : expr),
      isValue v -> Step (ExpLet v e) (subBV v e)
  where "e '~~>' e1" := (Step e e1).

Inductive EvalsTo : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Refl     : forall (e : expr),  EvalsTo e e
  | AddStep  : forall (e1 e2 e3 : expr),
        Step e1 e2 -> EvalsTo e2 e3 -> EvalsTo e1 e3.

Definition LCsubst (th:csub) : Prop :=
  (fix f (th':csub) := match th' with
    | CEmpty => True
    | CCons x v th'' => isLC v /\ f th''
    end) th.

Lemma LCsubst_empty : LCsubst CEmpty.
Proof. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma LCsubst_cons : forall x v th, LCsubst (CCons x v th) <-> isLC v /\ LCsubst th.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma LCsubst_tail : forall x v th, LCsubst (CCons x v th) -> LCsubst th.
Proof. intros x v th H. unfold LCsubst in H. simpl in H. destruct H as [_ H]; auto. Qed.

Lemma LCsubst_head : forall x v th, LCsubst (CCons x v th) -> isLC v.
Proof. intros x v th H. unfold LCsubst in H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H _]; auto. Qed.

Lemma csubst_Ic : forall th n, csubst th (Ic n) = Ic n.

Inductive SubClass: nomtype -> nomtype -> Prop :=
| SubCRefl : forall b, SubClass b b
| SubCTrans: forall b1 b2 b3, SubClass b1 b2 -> SubClass b2 b3 -> SubClass b1 b3
| SubCInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            SubClass  (TClass C) (TClass D)
| SubIInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is I fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds i,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            nth_error Is i = Some I ->
            SubClass (TClass C) (TInterface I).

Inductive FJSubtype: fjtype -> fjtype -> Prop :=
| SubBAny : forall t, FJSubtype t TAny
| SubBInt : FJSubtype TInt TInt
| SubBBool : FJSubtype TBool TBool
| SubBClass: forall C D, SubClass C D -> FJSubtype (TNom C) (TNom D).

Inductive csub : Set :=
    | CEmpty
    | CCons  (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub).

Fixpoint bindsC (th : csub) : names :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => empty
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => names_add x (bindsC th)
    end.

Definition in_csubst (x : vname) (th : csub) : Prop := Elem x (bindsC th).

Fixpoint bound_inC (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub) : Prop :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty             => False
    | (CCons  y v_y th)  => (x = y /\ v_x = v_y) \/ bound_inC x v_x th
    end.

Fixpoint closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => fv v_x = empty /\ closed th
    end.

Fixpoint loc_closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia ZArith Bool Arith.Wf_nat.
Require Import ListSet RFJ.Lists RFJ.Utils.Referable Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Definitions.Syntax Definitions.Semantics Definitions.Typing
  Definitions.CTSanity Definitions.SubDenotation Definitions.FJTyping.
Require Import devtest8 fuel uniq fwd imp ctx helpers.

Lemma sem_field_case : forall F,
  (forall m, m < F -> forall g e t, Hastype g e t -> forall th, DenotesEnv g th ->
     forall v, EvalsToN m (csubst th e) v -> isValue v -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) v) ->
  forall g e f t, Hastype g (ExpFieldAccess e f) t -> forall th, DenotesEnv g th ->
  forall v, EvalsToN F (csubst th (ExpFieldAccess e f)) v -> isValue v ->
  Denotes (ctsubst th t) v.
Proof.
  intros F Hsmall g e f t Hty th Hd v HN Hv.
  destruct (Hastype_to_D_sem g (ExpFieldAccess e f) t Hty) as [s [HD Htr]].
  destruct (HastypeD_field_inv g e f s HD) as
    [C [Fs [i [fi [ps [Heqs [Hlce [Hte [HRF [Hnth [Href]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst s.
  apply (Htr th Hd v).
  rewrite csubst_Field in HN.
  destruct (EvN_field_decomp F (csubst th e) f v HN Hv) as
    [n1 [C1 [Fs1 [es [fi1 [ei [i1 [H1 [HvalNew [HRF1 [Hnth1 [Href1 [HnthE1 [Hveq Hn]]]]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst v.
  assert (Hn1lt : n1 < F) by lia.
  rewrite ctsubst_self. rewrite ctsubst_TRefn. rewrite cpsubst_PEmpty.
  apply Denotes_self_eq.
  - assert (Hlc_th : LCsubst th) by (exact (DenotesEnv_LCsubst g th Hd)).
    exact (proj1 isLC_csubst_gen (ExpFieldAccess e f) th Hlc_th Hlce).
  - (* Denotes of the field type at the source receiver expression *)
    pose (HDrec := Hsmall n1 Hn1lt g e (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) Hte th Hd
                      (ExpNew C1 es) H1 HvalNew).
    destruct (Denotes_new_class_inv (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) (cpsubst th ps))
                (ExpNew C1 es) HDrec (TNom (TClass C)) (cpsubst th ps) C1 es
                eq_refl eq_refl)
      as [Fsd [HRFd [HPE [HF2d Hsubj]]]].
    assert (HFsd : Fsd = Fs1) by (eapply Reffields_det; [exact HRFd|exact HRF1]).
    subst Fsd.
    assert (HsubC : SubClass (TClass C1) (TClass C))
      by (apply (FJSubtype_class_inv C1 C); exact Hsubj).
    destruct (SubClass_reffields_prefix (TClass C1) (TClass C) HsubC C1 C Fs1 Fs
                eq_refl eq_refl HRF) as [Fs1' [suf [HRF1' Hseq]]].
    assert (HFs1' : Fs1' = Fs1) by (eapply Reffields_det; [exact HRF1'|exact HRF1]).
    subst Fs1'.
    assert (HiFs : i < length Fs) by (apply nth_error_Some; rewrite Hnth; discriminate).
    assert (Hnth1i : nth_error Fs1 i = Some fi).
    { rewrite Hseq. rewrite nth_error_app1; [exact Hnth|exact HiFs]. }
    assert (Hrefeq : ref fi = ref fi1) by (rewrite Href, Href1; reflexivity).
    destruct (nth_error_ref_unique Fs1 i fi i1 fi1
                (Reffields_NoDup C1 Fs1 HRF1) Hnth1i Hnth1 Hrefeq)
      as [Hii Hfifi].
    subst i1. subst fi1.
    assert (HiEs : i < length es) by (apply nth_error_Some; rewrite HnthE1; discriminate).
    assert (HlenT : length (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1)) = length es)
      by (exact (Forall2_length Denotes (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1)) es HF2d)).
    assert (HiT : i < length (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1)))
      by (rewrite HlenT; exact HiEs).
    destruct (nth_error_exists (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1)) i HiT)
      as [td Htd].
    destruct (Forall2_nth_error_Some Denotes
                (map (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1)) es i td ei
                HF2d Htd HnthE1) as Hden_td.
    destruct (nth_error_map_Some (tsubBV (ExpNew C1 es)) (map ReffieldType Fs1) i td Htd)
      as [y [Hy HyEq]]. subst td.
    destruct (nth_error_map_Some ReffieldType Fs1 i y Hy) as [fi' [Hfi' Hy']].
    assert (Hfieq : fi' = fi) by (rewrite Hnth1i in Hfi'; injection Hfi' as H; exact H).
    subst fi'. subst y.
    assert (Hfreefi : free (ReffieldType fi) = empty).
    { apply Reffields_free in HRF. rewrite Forall_forall in HRF.
      exact (HRF fi (nth_error_In Fs i Hnth)). }
    assert (Hlc_th : LCsubst th) by (exact (DenotesEnv_LCsubst g th Hd)).
    assert (Hct : ctsubst th (tsubBV e (ReffieldType fi)) =
                  tsubBV (csubst th e) (ReffieldType fi)).
    { rewrite ctsubst_tsubBV0; [|exact Hlc_th].
      rewrite (ctsubst_free th (ReffieldType fi) Hfreefi). reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hct.
    destruct (ReffieldType fi) as [bf psf] eqn:Hft.
    rewrite tsubBV_TRefn in Hden_td.
    rewrite tsubBV_TRefn.
    assert (HlceE : isLC (csubst th e))
      by (exact (proj1 isLC_csubst_gen e th Hlc_th Hlce)).
    assert (HevE : EvalsTo (csubst th e) (ExpNew C1 es)) by (apply EvN_EvalsTo with (n:=n1); exact H1).
    assert (Hvei : isValue ei) by (exact (isValueL_nth es i ei HvalNew HnthE1)).
    exact (Denotes_tsubBV_rev_nc bf psf ei (csubst th e) (ExpNew C1 es)
             HlceE HevE HvalNew Hvei Hden_td).
  - rewrite csubst_Field in HN.
    apply EvN_EvalsTo with (n:=F). exact HN.
Qed.
EOF
cd /workspace && timeout 300 rocq compile -Q /tmp "" -I . -R . Top -R src RFJ /tmp/fieldcase.v > /tmp/field_out.txt 2>&1; echo "status=$?"; grep -B2 -A3 "Error:" /tmp/field_out.txt | head -8; grep -A 200 "Error:" /tmp/field_out.txt | tail -14

Lemma comm_subBV : forall p j k E w,
  j <> k -> isLC E -> isValue w ->
  subBV_at k w (subBV_at j E p) = subBV_at j E (subBV_at k w p).
Proof.
  refine (proj1 (syntax_mutind'
    (fun p => forall j k E w, j <> k -> isLC E -> isValue w ->
       subBV_at k w (subBV_at j E p) = subBV_at j E (subBV_at k w p))
    (fun (_:type) => True) (fun (_:preds) => True)
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)).
  - simpl; auto.
  - simpl; auto.
  - simpl. intros i j k E w Hjk HE Hw.
    destruct (j =? i) eqn:Ej; destruct (k =? i) eqn:Ek; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ej. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ek. lia.
    + try rewrite Ej. try rewrite Ek. simpl. apply (subBV_at_LC E k).
      apply isLC_at_mono with (j:=0); [lia|exact HE].
    + try rewrite Ej. try rewrite Ek. simpl. symmetry. apply (subBV_at_LC w j).
      apply isValue_isLC'; exact Hw.
    + try rewrite Ej. try rewrite Ek. simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl; auto.
  - simpl; intros o e IH j k E w Hjk HE Hw. rewrite (IH j k E w); auto.
  - simpl; intros o e1 IH1 e2 IH2 j k E w Hjk HE Hw.
    rewrite (IH1 j k E w); auto. rewrite (IH2 j k E w); auto.
  - simpl; intros e1 IH1 m e2 IH2 j k E w Hjk HE Hw.
    rewrite (IH1 j k E w); auto. rewrite (IH2 j k E w); auto.
  - simpl; intros e IH f j k E w Hjk HE Hw. rewrite (IH j k E w); auto.
  - intros C l HF j k E w Hjk HE Hw.
    rewrite subBV_New_map. rewrite subBV_New_map.
    rewrite subBV_New_map. rewrite subBV_New_map.
    f_equal.
    revert HF. induction l as [|a l IHs]; simpl; intros HF.
    + reflexivity.
    + inversion HF as [|? ? Pa Pl]; subst. simpl.
      rewrite (Pa j k E w Hjk HE Hw).
      f_equal. apply IHs; exact Pl.
  - simpl; intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 j k E w Hjk HE Hw.
    simpl.
    rewrite (IH1 j k E w); auto.
    rewrite (IH2 (j+1) (k+1) E w); auto. lia.
  - cbn; auto.
  - cbn; auto.
  - cbn; auto.

  Hypothesis Aeq_dec : forall x y:A, {x = y} + {x <> y}.

    match x with

Lemma fv_New_eq : forall c l, fv (ExpNew c l) = fvL l.

Lemma HasFJtype_to_D : forall g e t, HasFJtype g e t -> exists s, HasFJtypeD g e s.
Proof.
  intros g e t H.
  induction H as
   [ g b | g n | g x b Hb
   | g e op H1 IH1
   | g e1 e2 op H1 IH1 H2 IH2
   | g e1 e2 m t rt C ps H1 IH1 Hm H2 IH2
   | g e1 e2 m t rt C ps H1 IH1 Hm H2 IH2
   | g e f T C F i ff H1 IH1 HFs Hnth Href HT
   | g es C Fs Us fs HUs Hfs HFs HF2
   | g e_x b e b' nms Hwf Hx IHx Hbody IHbody
   | g e s t H1 IH1 Hsub ].
  - eexists; eapply DBC.
  - eexists; eapply DIC.
  - eexists; eapply DVar; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DUnOP; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DBinOP; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DInvok; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DInvokI; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DField; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DNew; eauto.
  - eexists; eapply DLet; eauto.
  - destruct IH1 as [s0 Hs0]; eexists; exact Hs0.
Qed.

Lemma HasFJtypeD_let_inv : forall g e1 e2 s,
  HasFJtypeD g (ExpLet e1 e2) s ->
  exists b b' nms, HasFJtype g e1 b /\
    (forall y, ~ Elem y nms -> HasFJtype (FCons y b g) (unbind y e2) b').
Proof.
  intros g e1 e2 s HD. dependent destruction HD.
  eexists; eexists; eexists; split; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_isLC_bound : forall g es Us m,
  esizeL es <= m ->
  Forall2 (HasFJtype g) es Us ->
  (forall e, esize e <= m -> forall g' t, HasFJtype g' e t -> forall j, isLC_at j e) ->
  forall j, Forall (isLC_at j) es.
Proof.
  intros g es Us m Hm HF2 Hrec j. revert Hm j.
  induction HF2 as [|e U es Us He Htail IHtail]; intros Hm j.
  - constructor.
  - simpl in Hm. constructor.
    + assert (Hle : esize e <= m) by lia. exact (Hrec e Hle g U He j).
    + apply IHtail. lia.
Qed.

Lemma HasFJtype_isLC : forall n e, esize e <= n -> forall g t, HasFJtype g e t -> forall j, isLC_at j e.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros e Hn g t HF j.
  - exfalso. pose proof (esize_pos e). lia.
  - destruct e as [b|z|i|x|op e1|op e1 e2|e1 f|e1 m e2|c l|e1 e2].
    + cbn; auto.
    + cbn; auto.
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (BV i) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
    + cbn; auto.
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpUnOp op e1) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
      simpl. eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
      simpl. split.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
      simpl. eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
      all: simpl; split.
      all: eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpNew c l) t HF) as [s HD]. dependent destruction HD.
      simpl. apply Forall_isLCL_at.
      assert (Hle : esizeL l <= n).
      { change (S (esizeL l) <= S n) in Hn. lia. }
      eapply Forall2_isLC_bound; [exact Hle | eassumption | exact IH].
    + destruct (HasFJtype_to_D g (ExpLet e1 e2) t HF) as [s HD].
      destruct (HasFJtypeD_let_inv g e1 e2 s HD) as [b [b' [nms [Hx Hbody]]]].
      simpl. split.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption].
      * assert (Hsize2 : esize e2 <= n) by (simpl in Hn; lia).
        pose (y := freshv nms).
        assert (Hy : ~ Elem y nms) by (apply freshv_notin).
        assert (HB : HasFJtype (FCons y b g) (unbind y e2) b') by (apply Hbody; exact Hy).
        assert (HL : isLC_at 0 (open_at 0 y e2)).
        { eapply IH; [| exact HB].
          unfold unbind. rewrite esize_open_at. exact Hsize2. }
        assert (HL1 : isLC_at 1 e2).
        { apply (isLC_open_at_inv e2 0 0 y); auto. }
        apply isLC_at_mono with (j:=1); [lia | exact HL1].
Qed.

Lemma Hastype_isLC : forall g e t, Hastype g e t -> isLC e.
Proof.
  intros g e t H.
  refine (Hastype_ind (fun g e t => isLC e)
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g e t H).
  - intros gg b. cbn; auto.
  - intros gg n. cbn; auto.
  - intros gg e0 op tt Hte IH Hsub Hlc. cbn. exact Hlc.
  - intros gg e1 e2 op tt tt' Ht1 IH1 Hsub1 Ht2 IH2 Hsub2 Hlc1 Hlc2. cbn. split; auto.
  - intros gg x tt Hb Hwf. cbn; auto.
  - intros gg e1 e2 m tt tt' rt C ps ps' Hte1 IH1 Hmty Hsub Hte2 IH2 Hsub2 Hlc2 Hlc1. cbn. split; auto.
  - intros gg e1 e2 m tt tt' rt I ps ps' Hte1 IH1 Hmty Hsub Hte2 IH2 Hsub2 Hlc2 Hlc1. cbn. split; auto.
  - intros gg e0 f C Fs i fi ps Hlc Hte IH HFs Hnth Hreff. cbn. exact Hlc.
  - intros gg es Ts C Fs Us fs HUs Hfs HLC HFs HF2 HSub2. cbn.
    apply Forall_isLCL_at. exact HLC.
  - intros gg e_x b e0 b' nms Hwfb' Hte IHx Hbody IHb. cbn. split.
    + exact IHx.

Require Import List.

Require Import Lists.

Require Import Nat.

Require Import ZArith.

Import ListNotations.

Definition var := nat.

Fixpoint find_w (n: nat) (key: var) (l: list var) :=
  match l with
    | [] => None
    | (x :: xs) => if key =? x then Some n else find_w (S n) key xs
  end.

Definition find_where := (find_w 0).

Section Ref.

Class Referable (A: Type) :={
                               ref : A -> var;
                               find: var -> list A -> option A :=
                                 let fix f (key: var) (l: list A) :=
                                     match l with
                                     | [] => None
                                     | (x :: xs) => if key =? (ref x)
                                                   then Some x
                                                   else f key xs
                                     end in f;
                             }.

End Ref.

Module Refs.

Definition refs {A: Type} {R: Referable A} (x: list A) := (map ref x).

End Refs.

Export Refs.

Require Import Definitions.Syntax Definitions.Semantics Definitions.Typing

Definition DirectParent (C D:ClassName) : Prop :=
  exists Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds,
    find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds).

Lemma SubClass_step : forall C1 C, SubClass (TClass C1) (TClass C) ->
  C1 = C \/ exists D, DirectParent C1 D /\ SubClass (TClass D) (TClass C).
Proof.
  intros C1 C H. remember (TClass C1) as b1 eqn:E1.
  remember (TClass C) as b2 eqn:E2. revert C1 C E1 E2.
  induction H; intros C1 C0 E1 E2.
  - subst b. injection E1 as ->. injection E2 as ->. left. reflexivity.
  - assert (Hb2 : exists C2, b2 = TClass C2) by (eapply SubClass_src_class; [exact H0|exact E2]).
    destruct Hb2 as [C2 Hb2].
    destruct (IHH2 C2 C0 eq_refl Hb2) as [Heq|[D [Hpar Hsub]]].

      * left. exact Heq2.
      * right. exists D. split; [exact Hpar|exact Hsub].

      eapply SubCTrans; [exact Hsub|].
      apply SubCInh with (D:=C2); [|exact Hb2|].
      (* recover direct parent equation from Hpar *)
      destruct Hpar as [Is [Fs [noDupfs [K [Ms [noDupMds Hfind]]]]]].
      exact Hfind.
  - injection E1 as ->. injection E2 as ->.
    right. exists D. split; [|apply SubCRefl].
    exists Is, fs, noDupfs, K, mds, noDupMds. exact H.
  - subst. discriminate E2.
Qed.

Lemma m_body_decl : forall m C body, m_body m C body ->
  exists D ps t rt e, mtype(m,C) = ps ~> t ~> rt /\
    mtype(m,D) = ps ~> t ~> rt /\
    MType_OK D (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) /\ body = e.
Proof.
  intros m C body H.
  induction H as
    [C D Is m0 ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds Hfind Hmfind
    |C D Is m0 e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds Hfind Hnone Hbody IH].
  - exists C, ps, t, rt, e. split; [|split; [|split]].
    + apply mty_ok with (D:=D) (Is:=Is) (Fs:=Fs) (K:=K) (Ms:=Ms); assumption.
    + apply mty_ok with (D:=D) (Is:=Is) (Fs:=Fs) (K:=K) (Ms:=Ms); assumption.
    + assert (HMT := CType_OK_MType C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds
                    (cok C D Fs noDupfs K Is Ms noDupMds Hfind)).
      rewrite Forall_forall in HMT.
      apply HMT.
      apply (find_in_MDefn m0 Ms (MDefn (MDecl rt m0 ps t) e)). exact Hmfind.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct IH as [D0 [ps [t [rt [e [Hm1 [Hm2 [Hok Hb]]]]]]]].
    exists D0, ps, t, rt, e. split; [|split; [|split]].
    + eapply mty_no_override; [exact Hfind|exact Hnone|exact Hm1].
    + exact Hm2.
    + exact Hok.
    + exact Hb.
Qed.
EOF

    Hastype g e2 t' ->

  forall v, EvalsToN F (csubst th (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2)) v -> isValue v ->
